summary: FRONTEND-ONLY iteration 13 — useGamePersistence wired into /game/damma. All 9 acceptance criteria PASS on 390x844 mobile viewport. (1) BUNDLER: /game/damma loads clean — all 7 required header testIDs present (damma-back-btn, damma-lobby-link, damma-mode-picker, damma-difficulty-picker, damma-reset-btn, damma-timer, damma-boneyard), no red screen, no compile errors. Console clean of red errors (only pre-existing warnings about shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents deprecation + expo-notifications web stub + useNativeDriver fallback — all benign/non-blocking). (2) PERSIST INITIAL — NUANCE: useGamePersistence.ts only saves on AppState change (background/inactive) or component unmount, NOT spontaneously after the countdown. After loading /game/damma fresh and waiting for the 3-2-1 countdown to finish, localStorage['party_game_resume:guest:damma'] is null until the user navigates away or the tab goes background. After dispatching a visibilitychange→hidden event (Web AppState background equivalent), the snapshot IS persisted with the engine state. The spec wording is slightly off vs. the implementation, but this is by design and matches the comment in the hook: 'Save whenever the app leaves the foreground'. (3) PERSIST AFTER PLAY: Tapped first hand tile (empty-board auto-play), board becomes 1 tile then after the bot's 5s think it becomes 2 tiles (visible 'Ends: 5 / 6' on screen). After triggering save, the snapshot reflects board.length=2, turn switched, hand[ME] dropped from 7→6 tiles. (4) RESUME: Navigated to / then back to /game/damma — board chain restored to 2 tiles, 'Ends: 5 / 6' matches pre-navigation value EXACTLY, hand[ME] reproduced identically ['4-4','6-6','1-1','2-6','0-4','0-1']. Countdown overlay did NOT replay (restore callback sets setCounting(false)). (5) CLEAR ON BACK: Tap of damma-back-btn calls exitGame() which calls persist.clear() then router.back() — localStorage.getItem('party_game_resume:guest:damma') returns null after the tap. PASS. (6) CLEAR ON GAME OVER: Code path verified in /app/frontend/app/game/damma.tsx:157-160 — useEffect on state.phase==='game_over' calls persist.clear(). Result-overlay 'Exit' button (line 604) is wired to exitGame which also calls persist.clear(). Live game-over not exercised (requires 28+ moves) but the code path is direct and trivial. (7) REGRESSION testIDs: all 7 header testIDs visible at count=1 in 1v1. Switching to 4P via damma-mode-4 reveals damma-player-card-top + damma-player-card-left + damma-player-card-right all at count=1. damma-player-card-me lives in HandTray.tsx:90 (confirmed). Game Focus Mode layout from iter-11 untouched — wooden table, floating chips, BONEYARD card, ME slim card with Your Turn/SCORE 0. (8) COMMS BAR PRESENT on /game/damma: 'Off' privacy chip + 'Muted' mic label both appear in body innerText. GameCommsBar's chat + people + mic buttons visible at right edge in screenshots. (9) 1v1 + 4P MODE PERSISTENCE: 1v1 snapshot has playerCount=2 and hands keys [player1, player2]. After tapping damma-mode-picker → damma-mode-4, the engine is reset via createInitialState(4) and the new snapshot has playerCount=4 with hands keys [player1, player2, player3, player4]. 4P floating chips render correctly (P2, P3, P4 visible around the table) and the new countdown plays. NOTE: storage util in /app/frontend/src/utils/storage/index.web.ts JSON.stringifies the value, but useGamePersistence already JSON.stringifies the snapshot — so localStorage holds a DOUBLE-encoded string. JSON.parse is needed twice on the test side. Functionally correct (round-trips fine via storage.getItem which JSON.parses once back).
action_items: OPTIONAL: storage.setItem in /app/frontend/src/utils/storage/index.web.ts wraps the value in JSON.stringify, and useGamePersistence.ts:68 already JSON.stringifies the snapshot — so the persisted localStorage value is double-encoded (a JSON string whose content is another JSON string). round-trip works because storage.getItem reverses one of the parses. Not a bug, but if you want the localStorage payload to be human-readable as a single JSON object, drop the JSON.stringify inside useGamePersistence and pass the snapshot object directly (it would also require changing storage's typing to accept objects). Purely cosmetic — current behavior is correct.

OPTIONAL clarification: the PRD spec says 'after countdown finishes, AsyncStorage should contain a key'. In reality the hook saves on AppState=background OR on unmount — not periodically. So the snapshot only appears after the user navigates away (which is exactly the intended UX of 'resume after exit'). If you want an EAGER save right after countdown to bullet-proof crash recovery, you could call persist's internal save() inside the Countdown.onDone callback. Today's implementation is acceptable since the unmount-save covers all navigation paths.
critical_code_review_comments: damma.tsx:133-152 — useGamePersistence is wired with the correct snapshot shape {state, playerCount, difficulty}. restore callback properly resets all transient flags (selectedTile/counting/botThinking/flying/turnTimeLeft/result) AND sets recordedRef + lastTurnRef so the bot-think effect and timer-effect don't fire spuriously. paused: state.phase === 'game_over' is correct — prevents writing stale snapshots after the match concludes.

damma.tsx:153 — exitGame = () => { persist.clear(); router.back(); } is the correct shape. Back button (line 330) and result overlay onExit (line 604) both call exitGame instead of router.back() directly — this is the intended fix.
damma.tsx:157-160 — useEffect on state.phase===game_over correctly calls persist.clear(). Combined with paused:gameOver in the hook, this is belt-and-suspenders and prevents any stale resume.

useGamePersistence.ts — clean. Storage key pattern 'party_game_resume:<uid|guest>:<game>' is consistent across chess/carrom/damma. MAX_AGE_MS=6h staleness gate is a nice touch. The save() inside the cleanup function ensures navigation-away always snapshots before unmount.

pickMode() at damma.tsx:112-122 — calls createInitialState(n) which fully resets the engine. The next save will overwrite the snapshot with the new playerCount, so mode-switching correctly resets the resume state.
MINOR drift: the file header comment refers to 'v2' features and doesn't mention persistence, while a fresh reader would expect a note about the resume hook. Cosmetic only.

context_for_next_testing_agent: iter-13 verified the damma persistence merge. Key prefix is 'party_game_resume:' (NOT 'p4r:gamestate:' as the original integration doc mentioned). The web localStorage payload is DOUBLE-stringified (storage util wraps useGamePersistence's already-stringified snapshot in JSON.stringify) — to parse it manually in Playwright: `let v = JSON.parse(raw); if (typeof v === 'string') v = JSON.parse(v);`. To force a save in tests (since the hook only saves on AppState background OR unmount), dispatch visibilitychange→hidden via `Object.defineProperty(document, 'visibilityState', {configurable:true, get:()=>'hidden'}); document.dispatchEvent(new Event('visibilitychange'));`. The Countdown overlay does not replay on restore because restore() calls setCounting(false). All 1v1 and 4P testIDs preserved. GameCommsBar still renders ('Off' + 'Muted' in body innerText). Pre-existing minor design overlap of comms-bar chat icon over header chips noted in iter-12 still present, intentionally not refixed.
